name: k5-frozen-seed2
title: Frozen evaluation after five evolution attempts

setting.evolution: five evolution attempts per task on seed 0 standard layouts
setting.layouts: Generalization tasks: standard layouts 1-5 and randomized layouts 1-5; other tasks: standard layouts 1-10
setting.protocol: every episode starts from the same snapshot, may revise procedures within the episode, and writes nothing back
setting.aggregation: task = mean over scored episodes; category = mean over its tasks; Average = mean over categories
